articles.title: Scope — all Luxembourg IFMs
articles.requirement: Applies to all CSSF-authorised Investment Fund Managers: UCITS Management Companies (Chapter 15 of UCITS Law), Authorised AIFMs, Registered AIFMs (where relevant), Super ManCos (dual-licensed). Includes IFMs managing SIFs / SICARs / RAIFs / Part II UCIs. Replaces Circular 15/612 reporting for the IFM population.

articles.title: Governance + organisational reporting
articles.requirement: Reports must cover: governance structure (board, audit committee, risk committee, remuneration committee); conducting officers + their allocated functions + time commitment; head-count per function (portfolio management, risk, compliance, internal audit, distribution, valuation); changes since last report; material organisational changes within the year.

articles.title: Delegation chain reporting
articles.requirement: Full delegation chain by function (portfolio management, risk management, distribution, valuation, transfer agency, fund administration, depositary): delegate identity + LEI + jurisdiction + group relationship; nature + scope; sub-delegations; oversight model + cadence; material delegate findings during the year. Required at the granularity of individual delegate + sub-delegate (post-AIFMD II).

articles.title: Funds + AUM reporting
articles.requirement: Per fund managed (UCITS / AIF — by type): name + LEI, ISIN(s), NAV + AUM (year-end + average), unit / share class structure, redemption frequency + notice, leverage method + ratios (commitment + gross), liquidity profile bucket, primary distribution geography, KID/KIID reference.

articles.title: LMT selection + activation reporting
articles.requirement: Per open-ended fund: list of selected LMTs (minimum 2, from Annex V); LMT activation events in the reporting period (date, trigger, decision authority, investor disclosure, CSSF notification timing). Annual LMT framework review attestation by senior management.

articles.title: Loan-origination metrics (LO-AIFs)
articles.requirement: Where the AIFM manages LO-AIFs: leverage ratio vs cap (175% closed-ended / 300% open-ended); single-borrower concentration vs 20% NAV limit; 5% retention compliance per transferred loan; recovery + workout statistics; credit-loss provisions.

articles.title: Risk-management metrics
articles.requirement: Risk-management framework: identified material risks per fund; risk-management resources (head-count + budget); stress-testing programme + key results; risk-limit framework + breaches in the year; reverse stress-testing for liquidity (where applicable). Linked to the AIFM's risk-management policy required under AIFM Law Art. 14.

articles.title: ICT-risk integration (DORA)
articles.requirement: ICT-risk framework integration: DORA Art. 5 governance arrangements; ICT third-party arrangements (Art. 28 register); reporting of major ICT-related incidents + the year's experience; resilience-testing programme + TLPT participation (where applicable).

articles.title: Sustainability-risk integration
articles.requirement: Sustainability-risk integration (SFDR Art. 4 + 6): policies + procedures; PAI consideration; per-product classification (Art. 8 / 9 / 6); year's portfolio-level sustainability indicators; integration into investment + risk-management decisions.

articles.title: AML integration
articles.requirement: AML/CFT integration: RC + RR roles + reporting lines; risk-based approach + business-wide risk assessment (refresh + date); CDD documentation + record retention; year's SAR statistics; training completion + content; specific arrangements for investor onboarding (incl. delegated investor-due-diligence).

articles.title: Submission frequency + format
articles.requirement: Annual report covering the financial year, submitted within 4 months of year-end. Ad-hoc reports required for material change (delegation changes, conducting officer change, LMT activation, ICT major incidents). Submission via CSSF's secure eDesk portal in prescribed XML / structured format.
